goal: Prevent Guix builds on 31.x from pulling stale archives from other checkouts and building the wrong sources
Avoid breaking developer and CI builds when running newer CMake versions on the 31.x maintenance branch

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it protects release build integrity by ensuring Guix builds do not reuse unhashed tarballs
P2 because it keeps developer builds functioning across newer CMake releases on the maintenance branch
